name: AECi — Retention prune not running (no daily run)
message:
No §7.4 retention prune has completed in roughly the last day (AECI-584, 03:00 UTC cron). `aeci.retention.prune` is emitted on EVERY completed run — ok, skipped, or failed — so an absence means the cron did not fire or the isolate died before the job finished, not that there was nothing to delete (a run with nothing to delete still emits `outcome:ok`).

This is the quiet failure this job is most prone to, because for most of its life it deletes nothing and would otherwise look identical whether it ran or not. Check the production API Worker's scheduled invocations in the Cloudflare dashboard, `wrangler tail` (`source:retention-prune-cron`), that `"0 3 * * *"` is still in `apps/api/wrangler.jsonc`'s production `triggers.crons`, and the `retention-prune` row on /admin/system. A `job_runs` row with `finished_at` NULL means the run started and never came back.

Nothing is lost while it is down — the table simply keeps growing, and the next successful run cuts to the same whole-day boundary.

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#retention-prune-skipped-failed-or-not-running
